title: A unit-distance graph in the plane with independence ratio below 1/4
summary: We prove that there exists a finite unit-distance graph in the plane with independence ratio strictly smaller than 1/4, answering a question of Erdős. Our proof closely follows the framework of Matolcsi, Ruzsa, Varga, and Zsámboki, based on the geometric fractional chromatic number, but adds a carefully chosen two-vertex augmentation that pushes their 27-vertex construction from geometric fractional chromatic number $4$ to a value strictly larger than 4.
